summary: Optional Codex Computer Use real-machine validation lane. It is default-disabled, non-blocking, and may only be activated after an explicit user request.

acceptedActivationSignals: User explicitly asks Codex to run Computer Use validation

workflow.summary: Read latest current truth, monitor, gate, and Zotero E2E artifacts to choose the smallest visible target.
Use Codex desktop Computer Use tools to inspect the real host UI only after the user explicitly requested this lane.
Record verdict, target, observed evidence, risks, and blockers back into the lane artifact.

nonGoals: Do not run during npm run check, agent:gate, release gate, or default Zotero E2E.
Do not replace agent:zotero:e2e, surface smoke, surface-local evidence, or gate verdicts.
Do not use Computer Use as a generic UI macro recorder or arbitrary desktop automation path.
Do not treat this optional lane as current truth unless a controller manually promotes a result.
